sources.entry: LocalSites - Simple Menu Bar (Status Bar) App for macOS listing local Bonjour websites (as Safari 11 no longer has Bonjour Bookmarks).

summary.one_liner: LocalSites is a macOS menu bar app (with an iOS counterpart) that lists local Bonjour websites advertised as _http._tcp services and opens them in a browser.
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS status bar and lists all _http._tcp services in the local Bonjour domain. Selecting an entry opens that site. With no modifier keys, sites open in the system default browser; holding option, control, or shift before opening the menu picks a different browser, as described in the About box. Version 1.4 groups menu entries by domain. Version 1.2 added a preference to show a monochrome menu icon. The README also describes an iOS target that lists local Bonjour websites and opens them in iOS Safari. The author built it because Safari 11 removed Bonjour bookmarks, which they relied on to reach avahi-based LEDE Linux devices by name.
use_cases: Find and open local network device web UIs by name
Access routers or embedded devices advertising via Bonjour/avahi
Open local websites in a chosen browser from the menu bar
Browse _http._tcp services on the local domain from an iPhone or iPad
notable: Lists Bonjour _http._tcp web services on the local domain
Modifier keys (option, ctrl, shift) choose which browser opens the site
Also has an iOS version that opens sites in Safari
caveats: README gives no install or build instructions
Targets Safari on iOS only, with browser choice described for macOS
Author describes it as a small personal project; no maintenance status is stated
